didYouMeanOrdering: case-sensitive Levenshtein distance over Unicode scalar values
sourceRanges.limitDiagnosticRanges: first excess scalar, token, modifier item, or structured node in original UTF-16 coordinates; chart byte limit covers the scalar whose UTF-8 encoding crosses the budget

symbolPolicy.standaloneWhitespace: reject leading, trailing, or inter-region whitespace; whitespace is accepted only inside a parenthesized modifier list where the grammar declares it
symbolPolicy.extensionStorage: highest named extension only; T1 owns semantic closure
symbolPolicy.sourceText: preserve every accepted code unit exactly
symbolPolicy.unknownInput: typed refusal; never strip suffixes or default to a major triad
symbolPolicy.limitDiagnosticPrecedence: a symbol code-point, token, or modifier limit is the sole diagnostic in that delegated symbol result; earlier ordinary diagnostics are suppressed
symbolPolicy.unicodeAccidentals: accepted for roots, slash basses, and supported modifier accidentals; formatting follows the requested accidental style

chartPolicy.documentMode: headers and at least one named section are required; @meter is mandatory
chartPolicy.fragmentMode: headers are forbidden; named sections or one implicit section are accepted; request meter supplies capacity
chartPolicy.repeatScope: nearest preceding expanded chord event in the same section, including a prior repeat, across measure boundaries; reset at every section
chartPolicy.repeatCopies: ChordSpec only; never annotation, duration, range, ordinal, or persistent identity
chartPolicy.durationArithmetic: exact normalized quarter-note rationals only; no floating-point allocation
chartPolicy.wholeDraftApply: authorized only on an ok result; insertableChords never authorize partial chart commit
chartPolicy.attachedSectionRecovery: malformed material attached directly to a section marker invalidates that same-line body; a later LF or CRLF is an explicit recovery boundary for independently valid insertable chords, while bare CR is not a line end and never reopens recovery
chartPolicy.limitDiagnosticPrecedence: an outer chart limit is the sole outer diagnostic; a localized delegated symbol limit is one translated diagnostic while other safely delimited chart spans may still contribute diagnostics
chartPolicy.canonicalExport: canonical headers, named sections, explicit reduced durations, nonempty JSON-string annotations, no comments; a repeat emits slash syntax only when it links the nearest coherent immediately reusable event in the same section
chartPolicy.emptyAnnotationNormalization: absent and explicitly empty section/event annotations both mean no semantic annotation; parser sourceText and event annotationRange retain source syntax, while canonical formatting intentionally omits empty JSON strings

limits.totalDraftLimitReachability: dominated: 8192 events times maximum 64 quarter-note measure capacity equals 524288, below 1000000

counterSemantics.sourceUtf16CodeUnits: input string length, observed without traversal
counterSemantics.sourceCodePoints: well-formed Unicode scalar values visited by preflight before completion or the first invalid scalar
counterSemantics.sourceUtf8Bytes: UTF-8 bytes visited through the same valid scalar prefix; full byte count for well-formed input
counterSemantics.maxDecodedTextCodePointsObserved: largest decoded header, section-name, or annotation scalar count reached
counterSemantics.lexerCodePointsVisited: well-formed scalar values consumed after preflight by this operation's own lexical layer
counterSemantics.tokensProduced: complete syntax tokens emitted by this operation's own grammar layer, including the first token beyond its token limit
counterSemantics.parserTransitions: own-layer produced tokens consumed or explicitly skipped by deterministic recovery, one transition per token
counterSemantics.modifierItemsObserved: complete normalized modifier items observed by a symbol operation, including the first item beyond the modifier limit; zero for chart operations
counterSemantics.sectionsObserved: complete section records observed, including the first section beyond the section limit
counterSemantics.measuresObserved: complete measure records observed globally, including the first measure beyond a per-section limit
counterSemantics.slotsObserved: complete chord or repeat slots observed, including the first slot beyond the event limit
counterSemantics.chordDelegations: complete chord-symbol spans actually delegated to the symbol parser
counterSemantics.numericComponentsCompared: explicit duration numerator and denominator significant slices checked for zero and bounded decimal magnitude; zero outside chart parsing
counterSemantics.maxSourceBigIntDigits: maximum significant decimal source digits passed to BigInt; zero when no source component is constructed and never greater than 13
counterSemantics.suggestionsCompared: versioned suggestion-table candidates actually compared by a symbol operation; zero for chart operations
counterSemantics.diagnosticsProduced: diagnostic records on the returned branch: errors on failure or warnings on success
counterSemantics.insertableCandidatesProduced: insertableChords entries present on the returned failure branch
counterSemantics.peakTokenRecords: maximum simultaneously retained operation-owned token records, including an active delegated symbol parser
counterSemantics.peakDraftNodes: maximum simultaneously retained draft root, section, measure, and event records allocated or copied by the operation; caller-owned input is excluded

parseChordSymbol.evidenceMode: lex and parse the bounded symbol source

parseChartText.evidenceMode: lex and parse the bounded chart source with chart-only lexical counters plus ordered per-delegation symbol evidence

formatChordSymbol.evidenceMode: preflight chord.sourceText for well-formed Unicode, then validate and format the supplied AST without lexing or reparsing sourceText

formatChartText.evidenceMode: preflight draft.sourceText for well-formed Unicode, then validate draft records in the documented exact order and delegate each reached event chord to the symbol formatter without lexing or reparsing sourceText; structural and returned-diagnostic counters are exact
formatChartText.nestedSymbolDiagnosticRange: replace every delegated formatter diagnostic range with the current chart event symbolRange for literal and repeat events; never offset chord.sourceText coordinates
formatChartText.unaddressableDecodedFieldRefusal: never reparse sourceText or guess a component range: decoded header faults use chart.draft_unformattable at zero range, section name/annotation faults use the owning section range, event decoded-invalid-scalar faults use the event range, and only an event text-limit fault may use its stored complete annotationRange

delegatedSymbolEvidence.order: zero-based delegationOrdinal in ascending chart symbolRange source order
delegatedSymbolEvidence.range: chart-coordinate range of the complete delegated literal chord span
delegatedSymbolEvidence.evidence: byte-identical SyntaxWorkEvidence from parseChordSymbol over the parseChartText input sourceText.slice(symbolRange.start, symbolRange.end)
delegatedSymbolEvidence.outerCounters: outer source, lexer, token, parser, modifier, suggestion, and termination counters never sum delegated values; modifierItemsObserved and suggestionsCompared are zero
delegatedSymbolEvidence.outerPeaks: peakTokenRecords and peakSuggestionRecords remain operation-wide and include the one active delegated parser
delegatedSymbolEvidence.recovery: a localized delegated limit keeps its nested symbol termination while outer termination remains complete when chart recovery reaches end of source

bounds.allocationDivisions: exactly one per nonempty measure with at least one undurated slot that reaches allocation

workEvidence.boundaryEvidencePolicy: Every parse-side limit recipe is independently materialized from an exact expression, pins the resulting source length, identifies the zero-based first-excess scalar, token, modifier item, decoded text field, section, measure, or event, and pins that diagnostic's literal half-open UTF-16 range plus the exact terminating counter projection and termination value. Other counters are checked against these independent semantic definitions and bounds rather than implementation-specific allocation totals.
workEvidence.hostileDurationDecimalPolicy: Strip leading ASCII zeroes before bounds comparison while preserving raw source; an all-zero numerator or denominator is invalid and never reaches BigInt. Integer :p is bounded by 2147483647. Fraction :p/q first bounds q to a three-digit divisor of 960, then bounds p by 2147483647 multiplied by q before F1 reduction. Construct BigInt only from bounded significant slices. Reviewed exact maxima, max-plus-one, all-zero, near-2-MiB integer, rational-numerator, rational-denominator, and byte-max-plus-one recipes prove rejection and precedence with numeric work evidence.
workEvidence.scratchMemory: bounded by source plus operation-owned peakTokenRecords, peakDraftNodes, and peakSuggestionRecords; caller-owned formatter input is excluded; wall time and process RSS are observations only

forbiddenShortcuts: C9 or C13 represented without a minor seventh
production parser, formatter, or resolver used as fixture oracle
